title: Claude for
Small Business:
10 workflows, ranked
slides.subtitle: Most useful first. Our ranking, from Anthropic's own list.

slides.label: Speed to lead
slides.detail: Answers new enquiries on nights and weekends with real meeting times, and logs them in your CRM. Nothing sends until you approve.
slides.start: The customer who messages at 9pm goes to whoever replies first.

slides.label: Chase invoices
slides.detail: Checks who owes you money and drafts the reminders. Plan payroll also chases overdue invoices before it readies the run.
slides.start: Money owed is money you cannot spend.

slides.label: Close the month
slides.detail: Reconciles your books against payment processors, flags what does not match and writes a plain-English profit and loss for your accountant.
slides.start: Needs a connected accounting tool to be at its best.

slides.label: Monday brief
slides.detail: Cash, sales, pipeline, your calendar and your top priority on one page. Anthropic's example posts it to Slack at 6:30am.
slides.start: Start the week knowing the numbers.

slides.label: Proposal builder
slides.detail: Turns a voice memo and site photos into a proposal in your format, priced from your last three deals.
slides.start: You check the price before it goes anywhere.

slides.label: Plan payroll
slides.detail: Checks you will have the cash, chases overdue invoices and readies the payroll run for you to submit.
slides.start: Staged for you. You press the button.

slides.label: Check margins
slides.detail: The margin analyser is named in the May launch. Paste what you sold and what it cost and see which lines earn least.
slides.start: You can try a rough version in a normal chat today.

slides.label: Social content engine
slides.detail: Plans next week's content, for example a two-week posting calendar with captions for your approval.
slides.start: Useful, but a draft calendar is easier to replace than a late invoice.

slides.label: Grow pipeline
slides.detail: Finds prospects who resemble your best customers and writes outreach in your voice.
slides.start: Read every message before it goes out.

slides.label: Build agent
slides.detail: Turns a recurring manual task into a workflow you can run by name or on a schedule.
slides.start: Last because you need to know what to automate first.
